title: House
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='8' y='82' width='84' height='10' rx='4' fill='#4caf50'/>
  <!-- house body -->
  <rect x='24' y='48' width='52' height='36' rx='2' fill='#ffcc80'/>

  <rect x='24' y='48' width='52' height='36' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#ffe0b2' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- roof -->
  <polygon points='50,18 88,50 12,50' fill='#e53935'/>
  <polygon points='50,18 88,50 12,50' fill='none' stroke='#ef9a9a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- chimney -->
  <rect x='66' y='22' width='10' height='16' fill='#b0503c'/>
  <rect x='66' y='22' width='10' height='4' fill='#d77a66'/>
  <!-- door -->
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='16' height='22' rx='2' fill='#8d6e63'/>
  <rect x='42' y='62' width='16' height='3' rx='1' fill='#a1887f'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='74' r='2' fill='#ffd54f'/>
  <!-- window left -->
  <rect x='29' y='56' width='11' height='11' rx='1' fill='#81d4fa'/>
  <line x1='34.5' y1='56' x2='34.5' y2='67' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='29' y1='61.5' x2='40' y2='61.5' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- window right -->
  <rect x='60' y='56' width='11' height='11' rx='1' fill='#81d4fa'/>
  <line x1='65.5' y1='56' x2='65.5' y2='67' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='61.5' x2='71' y2='61.5' stroke='#e1f5fe' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- smoke -->
  <circle cx='71' cy='16' r='3' fill='#cfd8dc'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='11' r='2.5' fill='#b0bec5'/>
</svg>
